Meet Brooke

Professional Cuts and Shaves

Brooke Schwab

COP A CHOP Barbershop is a barbershop on S Main Street in Slippery Rock, PA, run by barber Brooke Schwab. The menu is haircuts, mullet cuts, beard trims, and hot towel shaves.

Brooke is credited with 11 years of experience. Bookings run through Squire, and the shop posts as @thebigchopppa.

The look book

Clean fades, classic cuts, and sharp finishes. Show your barber the one you want, or let them call it.
